scope: Generic adult male reference anatomy. Not an astronaut reconstruction, clinical anatomical certification or physiological simulation. Static geometry; no HR/RR animation or evidence mapping.

transform.note: Identical rigid rotation, uniform scale and translation for every original component; no per-organ registration or reshaping.

simplification: Deterministic per-element vertex clustering; cells body3mm/bones2mm/organs0.9mm, cluster centroids, degenerate/duplicate triangles removed, smooth normals rebuilt. Not clinical fidelity. Original geometry and hashes retained separately.
limitations: Source model may contain anatomical/concept-assignment errors; independent anatomical expert review not performed.
Whole-heart compound mapping is incomplete; preview explicitly selects three named chamber-wall surfaces.
Skin is an adult male reference; no claims about individual crew anatomy or sex.
No texture maps, compression extensions, skinning or animations. Derived meshes retain CC BY-SA 2.1 Japan.
